questions.question_en: Consider the following statements: 1. Speaker of the Legislative Assembly shall vacate his/her office if he/she ceases to be a member of the Assembly. 2. Whenever the Legislative Assembly is dissolved, the Speaker shall vacate his/her office immediately. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_en: 1 only
2 only
Both 1 and 2
Neither 1 nor 2
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Statement 1 is correct — if the Speaker ceases to be a member, they must vacate office. Statement 2 is incorrect — the Speaker does not vacate office on dissolution; he/she continues until the new Assembly meets and elects a new Speaker.
